import sys,json,subprocess,tempfile,csv,re
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/Users/bobsingor/GitHub/cloudpdf-platform/oss/embedpdf/packages/engine/main/test/fixtures/signature-compat')
from generate import reader,raw_body,describe_bytes
from generate_v3 import append_revision
from verify_v3 import normalized
from asn1crypto import cms
root=Path('/tmp/epdf-weak-nm-probes')
base=(root/'pdfs/approval-inline-control.pdf').read_bytes()
previous=(root/'supplemental/approval-inline-rewrite-size-preserved.pdf').read_bytes()
r=reader(base);page=r.root['/Pages']['/Kids'].raw_get(0)
data=append_revision(base,{page.idnum:raw_body(base,page.idnum)})
assert data.startswith(base)
assert data[len(base):].split(b'xref\n')[0] == previous[len(base):].split(b'xref\n')[0]
assert raw_body(data,page.idnum)==raw_body(base,page.idnum)
new=reader(data)
assert normalized(r.root)==normalized(new.root)
for ref in r.root['/AcroForm']['/Fields']:assert raw_body(base,ref.idnum)==raw_body(data,ref.idnum)
assert int(new.trailer['/Size'])==int(r.trailer['/Size'])
assert [v.original_bytes for v in new.trailer['/ID']]==[v.original_bytes for v in r.trailer['/ID']]
expected=previous[len(base):].replace(b'xref\n0 1\n0000000000 65535 f \n6 1\n',b'xref\n6 1\n')
expected=expected.replace(b'/ID [ <455044462d636f727075732d7630303121> <455044462d636f727075732d7630303121> ]',b'/ID [ (EPDF\\055corpus\\055v001\\041) (EPDF\\055corpus\\055v001\\041) ]')
assert base+expected==data, 'Expected only xref zero entry removal and ID lexical representation difference'
facts=describe_bytes(data);assert all(s['digestMatches'] for s in facts['signatures'])
sig=new.embedded_signatures[0].sig_object;ranges=sig['/ByteRange']
signed=b''.join(data[int(ranges[i]):int(ranges[i])+int(ranges[i+1])] for i in range(0,len(ranges),2))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='epdf-raw-rewrite-cms-') as temporary:
 t=Path(temporary);(t/'sig.der').write_bytes(cms.ContentInfo.load(sig['/Contents'].original_bytes).dump());(t/'signed.bin').write_bytes(signed)
 result=subprocess.run(['openssl','cms','-verify','-inform','DER','-in',str(t/'sig.der'),'-content',str(t/'signed.bin'),'-binary','-noverify','-out','/dev/null'],capture_output=True)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
case_id='approval-inline-rewrite-reference-writer'
file=root/'supplemental'/f'{case_id}.pdf';assert not file.exists();file.write_bytes(data)
p=root/'supplemental/manifest.json';m=json.loads(p.read_text());m['cases'].append({'id':case_id,'file':file.name,'profile':'approval','layout':'inline','action':'rewrite-reference-writer','facts':facts,'pageObjectNumber':page.idnum,'pageBodyByteIdentical':True,'cmsVerified':True,'acrobat':'unobserved','differenceFrom':'approval-inline-rewrite-size-preserved','difference':'Same signed baseline and byte-identical page rewrite; use corpus v3 append_revision writer. Only removes xref object zero free entry and encodes identical document ID bytes as literal strings rather than hex strings. Size, object offsets, and startxref remain the same. Does not rewrite the signature widget.'});p.write_text(json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n')
p=root/'acrobat-checklist.csv'
with p.open(newline='') as f:r=csv.DictReader(f);fields=r.fieldnames;rows=list(r)
rows.append(dict(id=case_id,file='supplemental/'+file.name,sha256=facts['sha256'],profile='approval',layout='inline',action='rewrite-reference-writer'))
with p.open('w',newline='') as f:w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
test=(root/'rewrite.test.ts').read_text().replace('unchanged page rewrite','reference-writer unchanged page rewrite').replace('approval-inline-rewrite-unchanged.pdf',file.name).replace('supplemental/engine-${runtime}.json','supplemental/reference-writer-engine-${runtime}.json')
(root/'rewrite-reference-writer.test.ts').write_text(test)
(root/'rewrite-reference-writer.config.mts').write_text((root/'rewrite.config.mts').read_text().replace("['rewrite.test.ts']","['rewrite-reference-writer.test.ts']"))
print(json.dumps({'file':str(file),'sha256':facts['sha256'],'cmsVerified':True,'pageAndSignedPrefixUnchanged':True}))
